description: Defines the Contract entity class with fields for contract details and relationships to User and Client entities, using JPA annotations.

classes.name: Contract
classes.description: Entity class representing a contract with fields for id, title, filename, created date, acceptance status, associated users, client, and value.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the contract.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the contract.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Retrieves the filename associated with the contract.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename associated with the contract.

methods.name: getCreated
methods.description: Retrieves the creation timestamp of the contract.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the contract.

methods.name: isAccepted
methods.description: Checks if the contract has been accepted.

methods.name: setAccepted
methods.description: Sets the acceptance status of the contract.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Retrieves the author User associated with the contract.

methods.name: setAuthor
methods.description: Sets the author User associated with the contract.

methods.name: getAcceptedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the User who accepted the contract.

methods.name: setAcceptedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who accepted the contract.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Client for the contract.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Sets the associated Client for the contract.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the contract.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the contract.
